name: Freeform Pool
headline: Soft curves for a garden setting.
tagline: A compact freeform shell with a curved outline and a molded bench. Suits gardens, resorts and spaces where a rectangle feels too formal.

images.alt: Blue freeform fiberglass pool shell standing on its side in the workshop yard while a worker finishes the inside surface, showing the curved outline and a molded bench.
images.caption: Finishing the gelcoat in the workshop

priceNote: Shell only. Delivery and installation quoted per site.

features.title: Curved outline
features.body: A freeform shape with no sharp corners blends into planting, rocks and garden paths.

features.title: Molded bench
features.body: A wide seat along one side for sitting in the water.

features.title: Smooth gelcoat interior
features.body: The finished surface comes from the mold, with no plaster or tiles to maintain.

features.title: Rolled top edge
features.body: A rounded rim that can be finished with stone, concrete or tile.
